title: Uhlmann Gauge Gravity: Spacetime from Purification Gauge Symmetry and Quantum Fisher Geometry

contributions.purpose: 提出一个从量子信息几何涌现时空的候选量子引力理论
contributions.mechanism: 将密度矩阵纯化 w 的选择自由提升为局部 purification gauge symmetry,把时空度规 g_μν 认同为量子 Fisher(Bures)度规,引入 Uhlmann 联络/曲率,构造微分同胚+规范不变作用(Einstein-Hilbert + Yang-Mills 型 F∧F + Fisher 梯度项)
contributions.evaluation: 理论论证:长波极限退化为广义相对论,Fisher/Uhlmann 项为 Planck 压低修正
contributions.domain: 量子引力 / 量子信息几何(纯理论)
contributions.source_quote: We propose a new candidate theory of quantum gravity, Uhlmann Gauge Gravity (UGG), in which spacetime geometry emerges from the information geometry of local quantum states and a novel gauge principle associated with purification redundancy.

contributions.purpose: 给出可证伪的实验预言
contributions.mechanism: 在平坦 Fisher 背景做线性化展开,导出引力波/黑洞可观测修正
contributions.evaluation: 三条 null-test 预言:GW 色散系数符号固定为正(GW170817 约束 |Δv|/c≲1e-15,ET/CE 可探至 1e-16)、偏振相关频率平方相移、黑洞熵 Fisher 曲率修正
contributions.source_quote: UGG yields three falsifiable predictions ... All three are null-testable: if absent at the indicated sensitivities, the entire framework is falsified.

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现的计算框架
contributions.mechanism: 发布计算晶格离散量子态 Fisher 度规与 Uhlmann 曲率的 agent 脚本(含固定随机种子、日志)
contributions.evaluation: 一键复现从信息几何输入到预言的全流程(仓库承诺接收后公开)
contributions.source_quote: All derivations are reproducible from released code computing Fisher metrics and Uhlmann curvatures for lattice-discretized quantum states.

self_declared_provenance.quote: UGG resonates with these insights but diverges crucially: it does not assume AdS/CFT or specific code subspaces. Instead, it elevates purification freedom to a fundamental gauge symmetry, providing new propagating fields and explicit dynamics.
self_declared_provenance.section: consistency and relation to prior work

self_declared_provenance.quote: The reduction to Einstein gravity can be justified by Jacobson's entanglement equilibrium argument.
